RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for WRITTEN ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Tuesday, the March 11, 2003/Phalguna 20, 1924 (Saka)
————
(Ministries:  Civil Aviation; Finance and Company Affairs; Petroleum and
Natural Gas; Tourism and Culture; Water Resources)
Total number of questions—155
443
WIN2\SESSION\7983RS 443
Open slots in airports to foreign
commercial flights
2007. SHRI RAJKUMAR DHOOT:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
have offered open slots in our airports to
foreign commercial aircraft;
(b) if so, the details of the Government
policy and of the foreign airlines who are
taking advantage of this policy; and
(c) the benefits accrued or likely to accrue
Air India and Indian Airlines by this policy?
Smoking at airports
†2008. DR. A.K. PATEL: Will the
Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that people
continue to smoke at airports despite the
prohibitory boards displayed there by
Government;
(b) if so, the number of persons fined
for smoking at different airports by
Government by the end of 2002; and
(c) the State-wise details in this regard?
Special purpose vehicle for airport
modernisation
2009. SHRI S.M. LAL JAN BASHA:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have floated a
special purpose vehicle to channel and raise
funds for the airport modernisation;
(b) whether it is a fact that private
participation has been invited for financing
the modernisation works;
(c) to what extent private funds will
contribute to the required Rs. 4000 crores;
(d) whether the special purpose vehicle
will issue debentures or bonds for this fund;
and
(e) if so, the details thereof?
Evacuation of Juhu Beach by AAI
2010. SHRI SANJAY NIRUPAM: Will
the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Airport Authority of India
has any plan to evacuate the Juhu Beach
Stalls in Mumbai;

(b) if so, the details thereof and whether
any evacuation notice has been served to
the stall owners recently; and
(c) if so, the details of the notice and the
reasons therefor?
Floating Joint Ventures for metro
airports
2011.SHRI GHULAM NABI
AZAD:
SHRI NANA DESHMUKH:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have decided
to float a joint venture with private corporate
for all the four metro airports and a separate
joint venture for each remaining airports with
five per cent equity of Airport Authority of
India;
(b) if so, what are the details; and
(c) whether the security angle has been
looked into in this regard?
Special purpose vehicle for Chennai
and Hyderabad airports
2012. SHRI S.M. LAL JAN BASHA:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether a special purpose vehicle
has been set up exclusively for the
modernisation of Chennai and Hyderabad
airports;
(b) the details of this special purpose
vehicle;
(c) the amount to be raised for this  SPV;
(d) the funds already raised from private
investors;
(e) whether State Governments will also
contribute for this purpose; and
(f) if so, the details thereof?
Non-utilisation of airports in
Karnataka
2013. SHRI K.B. KRISHNA
MURTHY: Will the Minister of CIVIL
AVIATION be pleased to state:
(a) whether Indian Airlines or private
operators are operating air services to
Bellary, Hubli and Belgaum in Karnataka;
(b) if not, the reasons for not utilising
these airports; and
(c) the steps proposed to be taken to
provide air services from these airports?
Investment of AIPFT money
2014. SHRI TARINI KANTA ROY:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) the organisations where Air India
Provident Fund Trust money is invested
along with the amount in each organisation
and returns received;
(b) whether there is any default; and
(c) if so, the action taken by Government
thereon?
Upgradation of Jaipur Airport
2015. DR. ABRAR AHMED: Will the
Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be pleased
to state:
(a) the details of progress of construction
work for upgradation of Jaipur Airport;
(b) the amount spent so far in this regard;
and
(c) by when, Jaipur Airport is likely to
be of International Standards?

WIN2\SESSION\7983RS1 445
Arrears due from private airlines
2016. SHRI SANTOSH BAGRODIA:
SHRI R.K. ANAND:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
are yet to receive arrears from private airlines
which have closed down their operations as
a result of Open Sky policy;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether these companies are making
timely payments; and
(d) if not, what penalties Government
intend to impose to such private airline
companies that are not making timely
payments?

(a) whether the utilisation of Air India's
fleet is low
